Marcos (CS): Morning team  quick check on cohort 7 enrollment and a couple of renewal flags. We need: owner for HelioTech outreach, confirm workshop time, and a short feedback form.
Denise (Sales): I can own HelioTech. Renewal reminder  they have an annual renewal on 2024-05-02. Adoption looks low from signal (only 1 successful run last week).
Marcos (CS): Thanks Den. I pasted a lightweight enroll tracker: https://redwood.app/sheets/beta-cohort7-2024  columns: customer, seats_enabled, runs_last_7d, first_success, renewal_date, notes.
Keisha (Eng): Ill prepare a micro-runbook for HelioTech focusing on common integration snags (SSO, CORS, webhook retries). ETA today noon.
Owen (Product): Proposed workshop: Thu 04/04 11:00am PT, 30-40 min. Agenda: 1) quick API checklist, 2) cost/batch knobs, 3) prompt best practices + Q&A. Prefer live Q&A over slides. Thoughts?
Rina (HelioTech): We prefer late afternoon PT due to engineering schedules. Also we use Okta SSO and a custom proxy; well send constraints.
Denise (Sales): Noted. Ill ask for attendee list and try to shift to 3:00pm PT.
Marcos (CS): Action items: Denise outreach (HelioTech) + confirm attendee list; Keisha eng checklist; Owen run the workshop and drop a 1-pager; Ill collect pre-reads and the feedback form. HelioTech with <2 runs -> mark as "at-risk" and schedule 1:1.
OnboardBot: Reminder: draft calendar event "Cohort 7 Beta: Customer Workshop" created. Waiting for time confirmation.
Keisha (Eng): Adding runbook to the sheet (tab "eng-ops") with quick debug commands and a snippet:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate || echo "check 401/403 and workspace scopes"
```
Marcos (CS): For the feedback form keep it to max 6 questions: usefulness, easiest feature, blockers, performance, docs clarity, next steps. Owen can you draft?
Owen (Product): Yup. Ill drop a Google form link in the sheet and add a short NPS-style item. Also will include a tiny opt-in for a short post-workshop interview.
Denise (Sales): Heads up  HelioTech legal asked about data residency. If unresolved, that could be a blocker for the renewal. Ill surface in the conversation.
Marcos (CS): Good catch. Flagging as potential renewal risk. If legal/workspace residency isnt resolved by 2024-04-20, escalate to Sales Ops + Legal.
Rina (HelioTech): Weve shared the proxy config and will try to have an engineer available for the workshop. Thanks for being flexible on time.
Marcos (CS): Recap and owners: Denise  HelioTech outreach & renewal note; Keisha  eng runbook + quick assist during workshop; Owen  run workshop + feedback form; Marcos  pre-read + post-workshop follow-up. Update thread with attendee names and any billing/logging screenshots.
Denise (Sales): Will ping HelioTech this afternoon and post update here.
Marcos (CS): Closing loop  Ill post an enrollment + risk update on 2024-03-20. If anyone spots a billing fail or legal redline earlier, call it out here so we can triage.
